items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet ruled out with a knee injury after being carted off in the fourth quarter of TNF vs NE; coach Ben Johnson said it 'didn't look very good.'
items.why: Carted off after hit on catch, unable to put weight on right leg; immediately ruled out.
items.implication: Elevates Colston Loveland to primary TE role and increased targets/snaps for CHI pass-catchers ROS short-term.
items.opportunity: Loveland route/target share expansion; possible Sam Roush snaps.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially didn’t practice for a second straight day due to his hamstring injury.
items.implication: High risk of missing or limited Week 7; monitor Friday report for status.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Xavier Worthy and other KC WRs if OUT.

items.text: Colston Loveland getting the usage over the last few games we all projected entering the season.
items.why: Recent snap/route trends matching preseason projection; amplified by Kmet OUT.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early due to a calf injury and is listed as limited.
items.why: Exited practice with calf; confirmed limited on report.
items.implication: Monitor progression; already high-volume post-Adams, any absence boosts TE targets.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, more TE share (Higbee/Parkinson); Ferguson delayed return prolongs Puka monopoly.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice (limited Thursday after Wed DNP) with quad; not ruled out for Week 7 vs MIA.
items.why: First practice since Week 3 quad injury; HC previously open to return.
items.implication: RB2 upside if cleared for substantial work; reduces Braelon Allen standalone.
items.opportunity: Reclaim lead role vs soft MIA run D if active without heavy limits.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed facility access for meetings, lifting, medical/non-football activities. MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers; OL mess contributes. Discussed long-term outlook on ROS Top-150 show.
items.why: Facility access signals progress; backups inefficient EPA.
items.implication: Positive ROS signal for Jacobs return/workload; handcuffs less appealing.
items.opportunity: Jacobs goal-line/early-down reclaim if cleared; Lloyd/Johnson poor efficiency limits their upside.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson was a limited participant Thursday (second straight day) after no early Wednesday presence; HC noted limited work; reports of walking with limp.
items.implication: Expected to play but monitor mobility/limp for Week 7 vs CIN efficiency.
items.opportunity: If limited snaps, Huntley or reduced rushing upside.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson (Adams beneficiary) not expected ready off IR soon ('will take some time'). Rams' only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson delay + Adams LTIR leaves Puka as primary option.
items.implication: Elite target volume ROS; WR1 locked even with calf monitor.

items.text: 10 Facts: Ashton Jeanty held under 3 YPC in 4/5 recent, low snaps; Mike Washington season-high 33% snaps/near equal rushes. Jalen Coker out-targeted/outscored Tetairoa McMillan in shared games. Bo Nix aDOT 5.4 (no deep). AJ Brown buy on share. Stroud QB1 upside.
items.implication: Jeanty downgrade risk if inefficient; Coker stash/start over McMillan; Nix/WRs fade; Brown buy.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, 33% target share, 97% routes despite drops; Bears good yardage spot.
items.opportunity: High route/target share in favorable game script.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11): elite volume in strong matchup.

Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6), Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12): big workloads/friendly matchups (Lions/NO/TB/CAR run Ds soft); Saquon 'in line' to play vs DAL (RB15, efficient).
items.why: Workload + matchup juice; Saquon efficiency on return.
items.implication: Start with confidence; Saquon RB2/flex floor.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32), Josh Downs @ MIN (WR41), Travis Kelce @ SEA (TE9), Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18), Cam Skattebo @ HOU (RB37): nasty matchups, role/target issues, Jacobs layoff workload Qs.
items.implication: Sit or fade in most formats.
items.conflict: Levitan more positive on Jacobs facility progress.

items.text: JJ McCarthy YPT to Justin Jefferson only 5.7 (vs Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9). Different scheme/coaches/small sample but tough to ignore; Giants starting McCarthy vs HOU.
items.implication: Temper Jefferson expectations short-term with McCarthy under center.
items.opportunity: Still volume king but efficiency risk; monitor aDOT/completion.
